items.text: Road safety: know the 12 Traffitech offences and penalties before you drive
Speeding: ₵120 – ₵300 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Jumping a red light: ₵120 – ₵360 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Using a mobile phone while driving: up to ₵600 fine or up to 3 months' imprisonment, or both
Failing to wear a seat belt: ₵120 – ₵600 fine or up to 8 months' imprisonment, or both
Failing to stop or yield at stop / yield signs: ₵120 – ₵360 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Overtaking at a pedestrian crossing: ₵120 – ₵300 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Disobeying traffic signs, barricades or road instructions: ₵120 – ₵300 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Obstructing an intersection or pedestrian crossing: ₵120 – ₵300 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Driving on the shoulder of the road: ₵120 – ₵300 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
Riding without a helmet or reflective clothing: ₵300 – ₵600 fine or 1 – 3 months' imprisonment, or both
Driving on railways: ₵60 – ₵300 fine or up to 30 days' imprisonment, or both
